entities.name: Great Stupas and Hydraulic Civilization
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The construction of the massive Ruwanwelisaya, Jetavanaramaya (one of the tallest ancient structures), and Abhayagiriya stupas, the development of the extraordinary tank (reservoir) irrigation system, and the Sigiriya rock fortress.
